## QC on Reads
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda activate sequali-env
sequali --outdir outputs/Z_pseudorouxii/sequali data/Z_pseudorouxii/...

sequali --outdir outputs/L_thermotolerans/sequali data/L_thermotolerans/...

sequali --outdir outputs/T_delbrueckii/sequali data/T_delbrueckii/...
conda deactivate
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
reads_path
```

## Assembly
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda activate flye-env
flye --nano-raw data/Z_pseudorouxii/... --out-dir outputs/Z_pseudorouxii/flye --threads 8 --genome-size 10m

flye --nano-raw data/L_thermotolerans/... --out-dir outputs/L_thermotolerans/flye --threads 8 --genome-size 10m

flye --nano-raw data/T_delbrueckii/... --out-dir outputs/T_delbrueckii/flye --threads 8 --genome-size 9m
conda deactivate
```
